properties.name: Classic McEliece 6960119 (Code-Based Key Encapsulation Mechanism)
properties.complexity_bounds: Decoding: O(t^2 * m) operations, m=13, n=6960, t=119
properties.algebraic_structure: Binary Goppa code over finite field GF(2^13) defined by irreducible polynomial g(x)

properties.name: Patterson's Algorithm / Berlekamp-Massey Syndrome Decoding
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(t^2) finite field GF(2^13) multiplications; Space: O(t)
properties.algebraic_basis: Solves error locator polynomial sigma(x) from syndrome polynomial S(x) over GF(2^13)
properties.algorithm_variant: Additive FFT / Cantor's basis polynomial evaluation for root finding

properties.name: GFNI (Galois Field New Instructions)
properties.throughput_bounds: 32 parallel 8-bit Galois field matrix-vector multiplications per 256-bit SIMD cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Galois Field Affine Transformation with Inversion in GF(2^8) on packed bytes
Multiply packed 8-bit elements in GF(2^8) defined by polynomial x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x + 1

properties.alignment_requirement: 32-byte boundary for aligned vector memory loads (VMOVDQA)

properties.operation: Accelerates syndrome decoding and error position calculation during decapsulation

properties.vector_width: 32x 8-bit GF(2^8) elements embedded for GF(2^13) field arithmetic per SIMD lane

properties.stage: Parallel multiplicative inversion stage in field extension construction for GF(2^13)
Byte-level parallel polynomial multiplication in Berlekamp-Massey update loop

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 256-bit vector registers containing 32 packed Galois field bytes
Read/Write 256-bit vector registers during syndrome matrix multiplication
